The '''sentry marker''' was one of multiple markers placed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] personnel while scouting out the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] placed at least one of these markers.<ref name="ESB">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novel]]</ref>
